name: Expanded Domain Magic
body:
You have learned to easily access a wider variety of spells on command.

Prerequisite(s): Legendary cleric, domain spells or equivalent ability

Benefit(s): Choose up to three spells on the cleric spell list. You may treat these spells as if they were also domain spells.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times, each time selecting three different spells.

Legendary Classes: Defenders of the Faith © 2024, Legendary Games; Jason Nelson, Aaron Hollingsworth, Amber Scott, Andrew J. Gibson, Carl Cramer, Clinton J. Boomer, Connor Bates, Jenny Jarzabski, Margherita Tramontano, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke, and Norman Mitchell Jr.
